title: Magic Studios: Your own local game asset studio
author: ilganeli
selftext:
Hi, all. 

I make games at Boundless Games, a small indie studio. We built [Magic Studios](Https://magicstudios.ai/welcome) for our own games and wanted to share it with the community. We've used this as our primary asset generation tool for several of our in-flight games.

This is a whole free game asset studio that runs on your own GPU - we are providing the hosted service to run it for you. Today, it makes ready-to-use sprites and videos (voice and screenplays included) from 2d concept art. Its primary operating mode is agent-driven, giving agents better structure and process for managing these workflows.


We will be open sourcing this app itself and will be adding our 3D modeling, rigging, and animation solution in the near future. 


Sprite animation:

- Upload one image of your character.
- Choose directions: one, side-scrolling, four or eight. If you only have a front view, it can draft the other directions. You check each draft before it is used. It never mirrors pixels.
- Choose and edit animations: idle, walk, attack, cast, or describe your own. Each result is a take you can keep or retry. Framing and pivot stay fixed within a clip.
- Export PNG frames and a JSON manifest.

Video:

- Make short movies from your images and a script, shot by shot.
- Make camera flights between location images.
- Review, cut and reorder takes before you export.

Coding agents can run all of it. An MCP server runs on your machine with your API key and works with Claude Code, Codex and Claude Desktop.

Cost: free. It runs on your own NVIDIA graphics card, tested on 16 GB and 24 GB of video RAM, or on your own Higgsfield key (Higgsfield bills you; we add nothing). Invited accounts can also use our shared machines, which may be busy.

Sign up free at https://magicstudios.ai with Google or an email and password.

I want to know where animations break for your art style, whether the export works in your engine, how it runs on your card, and where an agent gets stuck. Comment here or email admin@magicstudios.ai.

Thank you and enjoy!
